title: Trump "does not appear to give regard to US softpower" as he addresses economic leaders
summary: US President Donald Trump gave a long-awaited speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos on the US economy, while addressing Greenland, NATO and lambasting US allies. He said he does not want to use force to take Greenland but has called for immediate negotiations. FRANCE 24's Angela Diffley and Fraser Jackson tell us more about what his speech means in th…
